voiceLab.title: Voice lab
voiceLab.intro: A test build tool for the hands-free mode. Speech is recognised on this phone only: the lab sends and records no audio. Nothing you say becomes an entry, nothing is sent to Lotties and no baby data is read. Results stay on this screen until you export them.
voiceLab.linkHint: Test build only: measures how well this phone understands the spoken commands.

setup.onDeviceOnly: Recognised on this phone only. If the phone cannot recognise this language on the device, the lab says so: it never uses a server.

conditionHelp.C1: Quiet room, normal voice, phone 30 to 50 cm away.
conditionHelp.C2: Night voice: quiet and low, phone on the bed or table about 1 m away.
conditionHelp.C3: Background noise: a crying-baby or white-noise sound from another device at moderate volume, or the TV on.
conditionHelp.C4: Airplane mode, with the on-device engine: it must still produce text.

capabilities.title: What this phone reports
capabilities.failed: The phone did not answer. Try again.

downloadStatus.started: Download started. Check again in a moment.
downloadStatus.scheduled: The phone scheduled the download for later.
downloadStatus.unsupported: This phone cannot start the download from the app.

phrase.done: Every phrase of this run has an attempt. Change the engine or the condition for the next run, or retry a phrase.

errors.denied: The microphone or speech recognition permission was refused. Allow it in the phone's settings.
errors.language_unavailable: This language is not available for this engine on this phone.
errors.on_device_unavailable: On-device recognition is not available on this phone for this language. Nothing was sent anywhere.
errors.not_available: Speech recognition on the device is not available here (only in the phone app).
errors.busy: The recogniser is busy. Try again.
errors.audio: The microphone could not be used.
errors.interrupted: Listening stopped because the app left the screen.
errors.timeout: The recogniser did not answer in time.

reason.question: a question
reason.report: another time, a plan or a comment
reason.stray_number: a number that is not an amount

summary.title: Summary
summary.hint: First attempts only. Targets of the spike: accuracy 90 % in C1 and 80 % in C2 and C3, wrong actions 2 % at most and no wrong amount in C1, phrases 22 to 24 log nothing, latency median 1.5 s and 90th percentile 3 s, and in C4 every phrase produces text.

export.hint: A JSON file with the test phrases, what the phone heard, the parsed commands and the summary, through the share sheet. Free tries are not in it.

freeTry.title: Free try
freeTry.hint: Say anything to see what the phone hears and how the parser reads it. Free tries are not counted, not exported and gone when you leave this screen.

keys.title: Key logger
keys.hint: While this is open, every key a keyboard or a Bluetooth button sends shows here.
